requirements.label: 120 Total Credits
requirements.hint: The BM in Jazz and Contemporary Improvisation requires a minimum of 120 credits. Requirements follow the 2024-2025 Silent Advisor; SMTD students follow the curriculum of their admit year.

requirements.label: Non-Music credits (30)
requirements.hint: At least 30 credits outside music. Courses within Arts Administration, Dance, and Theatre also count as non-Music.

requirements.label: Music Theory and Musicology core
requirements.hint: THEORY 149 Written Skills I, JAZZ 114 Contemporary Basic Musicianship I, PAT 150 Experiential Music Theory, and MUSICOL 139 Intro to the Study of Music.

requirements.label: Musicology elective
requirements.hint: One Musicology elective, 2 to 3 credits. This must be beyond MUSICOL 139, which is separately required.

requirements.label: Musicology or Theory elective
requirements.hint: One additional Musicology or Theory elective, 2 to 3 credits.

requirements.label: ENS 460: Jazz Ensemble (4 terms)
requirements.hint: Four terms of ENS 460 Jazz Ensemble. The planner counts one election; repeat it across terms.

requirements.label: Additional jazz ensemble (4 terms)
requirements.hint: Four additional terms chosen from ENS 460 Jazz Ensemble or ENS 462 Small Jazz Ensemble, beyond the four core Jazz Ensemble terms. Repeat elections across terms count.

requirements.label: Performance lessons (24 credits)
requirements.hint: Private jazz study every term, minimum 24 credits or completion of JAZZ 402.

requirements.label: MUSPERF 440: Senior Recital
requirements.hint: Zero credit capstone recital in the final year.

requirements.label: Jazz core requirements
requirements.hint: JAZZ 113 Jazz Piano, 422 Jazz Styles and Historical Practice, 423 Black Music Matters, 432 Fundamentals of Rhythm, 442 Portfolio and Career Development, 470 Improvisational Forms, 466 Improvisation I, 467 Improvisation II, 471 Upper Level Improvisation, 468 Compositional Forms, and 469 Arranging I. JAZZ 432 is not yet in the planner catalog, so the audit counts 10 of the 11; verify JAZZ 432 by hand.

requirements.label: First year writing
requirements.hint: ENGLISH 124, 125, or an equivalent first year writing course.

requirements.label: Upper level writing
requirements.hint: An upper level writing course approved by the Sweetland Writing Center.

requirements.label: Race and Ethnicity course
requirements.hint: One course in Race and Ethnicity selected from approved courses within LSA, or within SMTD by petition. SMTD RE courses will not count into overall non-SMTD credits.
